prompt: Vera counts stars from the rooftop
title: Bright Stars
irony: Vera plans to count each star so none slip away, but she keeps them by losing count and dancing under them.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy, Benny and Vera climb the big-house rooftop under a spray of stars.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy opens his star book to count each star while Vera lays out neat charts.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox pops up the ladder and dares them to count each star tonight.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant the star hook together under the bright sky.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The count goes wrong when clouds cross and Vera recounts from one.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Knox shouts fast numbers, blankets tangle, and the count falls apart laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: They sing the star hook again, still trying to keep count.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Vera holds Benny's hand and admits her list cannot hold the sky.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Vera drops the chart and invites Teddy to watch and dance instead.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Vera sings the turned hook line as they dance beneath the stars.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They hum the hook on the rooftop as counting stops and dancing starts.
